'''Liefur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who along with [[Co'overma]] came to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to preserve local wildlife, specifically wild [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]]. He asked a passerby to release the nexu held by a group of pirates.<ref name="Making Trouble" />
